source: Schwartz WB, Brackett NC Jr, Cohen JJ. The response of extracellular hydrogen ion concentration to symptomatic hypercapnia. J Clin Invest 1965; 44(2):291-301.
claim: In a patient with chronic hypercapnia (chronic baseline PaCO2 55 mmHg) presenting with an acute exacerbation to PaCO2 72 mmHg, preexisting renal bicarbonate retention is preserved, yielding standard base excess (SBE) > +4 mmol/L rather than an uncompensated near-zero value.
